verdict.rationale: Jan is a local LLM runner, so cold-start latency and runtime footprint are a fair axis. The only related evidence is that the API server is 'powered by llama.cpp'. Nothing in the pack documents a lightweight runtime binary, cold-start times, or how fast inference begins after launch.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins
